description: The app's own commands for the list window, `main` in both clients (docs/design/architecture.md, the owner). Only it holds the sign-ins in the keyring, the server connections, voice, notifications and other windows' opening; build.rs declares every command, so no other window can call these unless its own capability file grants one. The old client is a single `main` window and uses all of them but autostart_state and autostart_set, the switch for starting Linger at sign-in, which only the Buddy list client's Settings shows (next-settings.json), and clipboard_image, which only the Buddy list client's message box asks (next-chat.json). dropped_files and dropped_file hand the message box beside the list the files just dropped on the window, on Linux (#673, src/dropped.rs), as they do the conversation windows. clip_start, clip_stop and clip_cancel record a voice message in the message box beside the list (#401, src/clip.rs), and the conversation windows may call them too (next-chat.json). next_request_attention (#291) is the Buddy list client's too: it flashes the taskbar for a DM, and the old client never calls it. voice_talk_key starts and stops the shell watching for the push-to-talk key with any app in front (#500, src/talk_key), only while the list window is in voice with push-to-talk on; voice_talk_key_reach says how far that reaches here, and Settings may ask it too. link_offered (#607, src/deep_link.rs) hands the list window a linger:// link an invite page's "Open in Linger" sent, already read strictly and turned into the link a person would paste; it only fills the paste box.
